course.title: Urban and Regional Economics
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Assume a city's geographic distribution of land use follows the bid-rent theory has three major land uses: commercial (0-2 km), residential (2-8 km) and agriculture (8 km \~). Suppose the city authority decides not to extend the residential services up 6 km as part of a zoning policy. Explain how the zoning policy will affect/rearrange the land use distribution. Who will benefit and who will lose in such land use policy.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2014
